text:
jules_csm: Nova Retail submitted a private onboarding for a text+image ranking model. They require VPC, BYOK/HSM, and a quantized 13B. Link to intake: https://forms.internal/nova-onboard. Renewal flag: this feature is tied to their annual renewal.

nova-customer: Confirming: data = purchase receipts + product photos. No PHI, but PII present. Expect bursty traffic around promotions (~150 qps). Latency target p95 <= 250ms.

mike_infra: Quick asks: 1) sample sizes (images avg bytes), 2) acceptable retry/backoff. We'll likely recommend Dedicated reserved nodes to meet p95.

anya_prod: Eval goals: MAP@5 >= 0.7 vs baseline, safety-leakage < 0.1%. Plan a 10k-sample eval set and a 2-week canary. Add runtime output-sanitizer.

dom_sre: Security: need AFA, KMS policy, and attestation for their HSM. We'll also require audit log delivery to their SIEM.

ops-bot: Ticket ORG-4972 created, owners: jules_csm, mike_infra. Due: 7 days for triage.

jules_csm: I'll collect samples and calendar for a 60-min enablement session next Tue. Nova will provide S3 staging creds after AFA.
